description: This file contains service functions for managing 'Execution' entities, including retrieval, updating, deletion, and handling public executions within a server-side application.

methods.name: getExecutionById
methods.description: Fetches an execution by its ID, optionally filtered by workspace ID.

methods.name: getPublicExecutionById
methods.description: Retrieves a public execution by ID and processes its execution data to remove credentials.

methods.name: getAllExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of executions based on provided filters, supporting pagination and date range filtering.

methods.name: updateExecution
methods.description: Updates an existing execution with new data, filtered by execution ID and optional workspace ID.

methods.name: deleteExecutions
methods.description: Deletes multiple executions by their IDs and clears related chat messages' execution references.
